Team / Bryan —

Finance confirmation below and attached sample pro forma (Helios_CreditPlan_v2.pdf). Summary decisions we need from the customer to proceed: PO number, billing legal entity, and whether credit should be applied on invoice issuance or back‑dated (we do not backdate credits before the MSA effective date).

Accounting treatment options (pick one):
1) Credit memo (contra AR): We issue a formal credit memo referencing the upcoming invoice. This will reduce AR when applied and will appear on the customer statement. GLA: Reduction to Revenue Reserve (GL 4205) and posting to Customer Credits (GL 2304) until applied.
2) Promotional allowance (deferred contra revenue): We record a promotional allowance liability and amortize or clear it against the first invoice. GLA: Promo Allowance (GL 5120) with a corresponding short‑term liability (GL 3408). This is preferable if you need the credit recognized over time for internal revenue recognition policies.

Typical for POCs/top‑ups: customers choose option 1 for immediate netting on first invoice. If Helios needs the credit to be disclosed as a separate promissory note for procurement, we can provide the pro forma credit statement with expected amount and conditions — see attached.

Timing: once we have the PO and signed MSA (signed‑MSA-Helios.pdf), finance can generate the credit memo within 1 business day and apply it on the next invoice run. If you need a dated pro forma earlier for procurement, we can provide that the same day.

Action items for Helios: please send PO number and confirm billing entity and chosen accounting option (1 or 2).

Thanks —
